notes: REF-BM-06: duplicate save returns 409 and surfaces the existing bookmark, but the only offered action is 'Save another copy'; no affordance to edit the existing item, so it blocks rather than converges to editing. REF-BM-10: tags are a plain comma-separated text input with no autocomplete/datalist of existing tags. REF-BM-14: search q is a literal LIKE over fields; no #tag syntax parsing. REF-BM-15: no AND/OR/NOT or parenthesised group parsing. REF-BM-16: no quoted-phrase exact-match handling; quotes matched literally. REF-BM-20: only per-item actions exist; no multi-select bulk actions. REF-BM-21: no bulk-apply-to-filter capability. REF-BM-23: a markdown note field can be written/stored and is searched, but it is never rendered/displayed anywhere when viewing and no markdown rendering exists. REF-BM-24: no local HTML snapshot or PDF download logic. REF-BM-25: no Internet Archive integration. REF-BM-29: no bundle entity/saved filter; favorites is a fixed scope, not a saved search+tag combination. REF-BM-30: no Netscape HTML import. REF-BM-31: no Netscape HTML export. REF-BM-32: no user settings (default sort/displayed items/font size); sort is a per-session URL param only.
